author: reek
body: The first two readings are a matched pair and the pairing is the whole instrument. Both reset the device and both then read the same PHY register through the same path; the ONLY difference is that one waits and the other does not. So the second reading cannot pass because the window is absent, which is the way an arm like this usually fails to test anything: if the window were not being enforced, the first reading would answer no.

author: reek
body: The unsettled read is expected to come back as the error sentinel rather than as zero. A driver that folded those together could not tell a PHY it may not talk to yet from a register holding zero, and the sentinel is what makes the distinction observable here.

author: reek
body: A reset with nothing after it, which is what this driver did before the settle existed.
